atoms.text: Adding 8 can be difficult. Here is a strategy to help you add 8.

atoms.sound: ssml: How do we solve this addition?<break time="1000ms"/>
ssml: First, we add ten.<break time="1000ms"/>It is easier to add ten than to add eight.<break time="1000ms"/>
ssml: Next, we subtract two.<break time="1000ms"/>This problem has the same answer because 10 minus 2 equals 8.
